description: This file defines the 'UnivariateStatistic' interface, which is implemented by various statistics classes in the Apache Commons Math library. It declares methods for evaluating statistical measures on data arrays and copying the statistic object.

classes.name: UnivariateStatistic
classes.description: An interface for all univariate statistics providing methods for evaluation and copying.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Computes the statistic on the entire array.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Computes the statistic on a subarray specified by begin index and length.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the statistic with the same internal state.
